name: ElectricalTakeoffSoftware.com
summary: An AI electrical takeoff service: upload plans, it counts devices and measures wire and conduit, and you pay per job only if you unlock the result.
differentiator: No subscription. Uploading and the takeoff preview are free, and you pay once per job only if you unlock it: $0.02 per square foot of floor area the electrical drawings cover, never less than $49 and never more than $2 per device counted. Its own worked example, an office building, comes to $469.
pricing: $0.02 per sq ft of floor area, from $49 a job, never more than $2 per device counted. Free upload and preview; you pay once by card only to unlock. No subscription.

scope.takeoff: Counts every device and measures wire and conduit from the drawing set, then lists the open items for you to settle.
scope.library: Not stated on the pages we read.
scope.laborUnits: Not stated on the pages we read.

materialPrices.note: The bid is priced by CSI section at rates you set. No price feed is named.

bestFor: Shops that bid a few jobs a month and would rather pay per job than per seat.
skipIf: You want a priced material database and labor units in a tool you run yourself.
watchOut: The price follows floor area, capped at $2 per device, so check the preview price on a large building with few devices before you unlock.
